controles.livre: Os filhos de Queros, os filhos de Sia, os filhos de Padom;

versos.hebraico: בְּנֵי־לְבָנָ֥ה בְנֵי־חֲגָבָ֖ה בְּנֵ֥י עַקּֽוּב׃

controles.web: the children of Lebanah, the children of Hagabah, the children of Akkub,
controles.kjv: The children of Lebanah, the children of Hagabah, the children of Akkub,
controles.livre: Os filhos de Lebana, os filhos de Hagaba, os filhos de Acube;

versos.hebraico: בְּנֵי־חָגָ֥ב בְּנֵי־שמלי בְּנֵ֥י חָנָֽן׃

controles.web: the children of Hagab, the children of Shamlai, the children of Hanan,
controles.kjv: The children of Hagab, the children of Shalmai, the children of Hanan,
controles.livre: Os filhos de Hagabe, os filhos de Sanlai, os filhos de Hanã;

versos.hebraico: בְּנֵי־גִדֵּ֥ל בְּנֵי־גַ֖חַר בְּנֵ֥י רְאָיָֽה׃

controles.web: the children of Giddel, the children of Gahar, the children of Reaiah,
controles.kjv: The children of Giddel, the children of Gahar, the children of Reaiah,
controles.livre: Os filhos de Gidel, os filhos de Gaar, os filhos de Reaías;

versos.hebraico: בְּנֵי־רְצִ֥ין בְּנֵי־נְקוֹדָ֖א בְּנֵ֥י גַזָּֽם׃

controles.web: the children of Rezin, the children of Nekoda, the children of Gazzam,
controles.kjv: The children of Rezin, the children of Nekoda, the children of Gazzam,
controles.livre: Os filhos de Rezim, os filhos de Necoda, os filhos de Gazão;

versos.hebraico: בְּנֵי־עֻזָּ֥א בְנֵי־פָסֵ֖חַ בְּנֵ֥י בֵסָֽי׃

controles.web: the children of Uzza, the children of Paseah, the children of Besai,
controles.kjv: The children of Uzza, the children of Paseah, the children of Besai,
controles.livre: Os filhos de Uzá, os filhos de Paseia, os filhos de Besai;

versos.hebraico: בְּנֵי־אַסְנָ֥ה בְנֵי־מעינים בְּנֵ֥י נפיסים׃

controles.web: the children of Asnah, the children of Meunim, the children of Nephisim,
controles.kjv: The children of Asnah, the children of Mehunim, the children of Nephusim,
controles.livre: Os filhos de Asná, os filhos de Meunim, os filhos de Nefusim;

versos.hebraico: בְּנֵי־בַקְבּ֥וּק בְּנֵי־חֲקוּפָ֖א בְּנֵ֥י חַרְחֽוּר׃

controles.web: the children of Bakbuk, the children of Hakupha, the children of Harhur,
controles.kjv: The children of Bakbuk, the children of Hakupha, the children of Harhur,
controles.livre: Os filhos de Baquebuque, os filhos de Hacufa, os filhos de Harur;

versos.hebraico: בְּנֵי־בַצְל֥וּת בְּנֵי־מְחִידָ֖א בְּנֵ֥י חַרְשָֽׁא׃

controles.web: the children of Bazluth, the children of Mehida, the children of Harsha,
controles.kjv: The children of Bazluth, the children of Mehida, the children of Harsha,
controles.livre: Os filhos de Baslute, os filhos de Meída, os filhos de Harsa;

versos.hebraico: בְּנֵי־בַרְק֥וֹס בְּֽנֵי־סִֽיסְרָ֖א בְּנֵי־תָֽמַח׃

controles.web: the children of Barkos, the children of Sisera, the children of Temah,
controles.kjv: The children of Barkos, the children of Sisera, the children of Thamah,
controles.livre: Os filhos de Barcos, os filhos de Sísera, os filhos de Temá;

versos.hebraico: בְּנֵ֥י נְצִ֖יחַ בְּנֵ֥י חֲטִיפָֽא׃

controles.web: the children of Neziah, the children of Hatipha.
controles.kjv: The children of Neziah, the children of Hatipha.
controles.livre: Os filhos de Nesias, os filhos de Hatifa.

versos.hebraico: בְּנֵ֖י עַבְדֵ֣י שְׁלֹמֹ֑ה בְּנֵי־סֹטַ֥י בְּנֵי־הַסֹּפֶ֖רֶת בְּנֵ֥י פְרוּדָֽא׃

controles.web: The children of Solomon’s servants: the children of Sotai, the children of Hassophereth, the children of Peruda,
controles.kjv: The children of Solomon’s servants: the children of Sotai, the children of Sophereth, the children of Peruda,
controles.livre: Os filhos dos servos de Salomão: os filhos de Sotai, os filhos de Soferete, os filhos de Peruda;

versos.hebraico: בְּנֵי־יַעְלָ֥ה בְנֵי־דַרְק֖וֹן בְּנֵ֥י גִדֵּֽל׃

controles.web: the children of Jaalah, the children of Darkon, the children of Giddel,
controles.kjv: The children of Jaalah, the children of Darkon, the children of Giddel,
controles.livre: Os filhos de Jaala, o filhos de Darcom, os filhos de Gidel;

versos.hebraico: בְּנֵ֧י שְׁפַטְיָ֣ה בְנֵֽי־חַטִּ֗יל בְּנֵ֛י פֹּכֶ֥רֶת הַצְּבָיִ֖ים בְּנֵ֥י אָמִֽי׃

controles.web: the children of Shephatiah, the children of Hattil, the children of Pochereth Hazzebaim, the children of Ami.
controles.kjv: The children of Shephatiah, the children of Hattil, the children of Pochereth of Zebaim, the children of Ami.
controles.livre: Os filhos de Sefatias, os filhos de Hatil, os filhos de Poquerete-Hazebaim, os filhos de Ami.

versos.hebraico: כָּ֨ל־הַנְּתִינִ֔ים וּבְנֵ֖י עַבְדֵ֣י שְׁלֹמֹ֑ה שְׁלֹ֥שׁ מֵא֖וֹת תִּשְׁעִ֥ים וּשְׁנָֽיִם׃ס

controles.web: All the Nethinim, and the children of Solomon’s servants, were three hundred ninety-two.
controles.kjv: All the Nethinims, and the children of Solomon’s servants, were three hundred ninety and two.
controles.livre: Todos os servos do templo, e filhos dos servos de Salomão, trezentos e noventa e dois.

versos.hebraico: וְאֵ֗לֶּה הָֽעֹלִים֙ מִתֵּ֥ל מֶ֨לַח֙ תֵּ֣ל חַרְשָׁ֔א כְּר֥וּב אַדָּ֖ן אִמֵּ֑ר וְלֹ֣א יָֽכְל֗וּ לְהַגִּ֤יד בֵּית־אֲבוֹתָם֙ וְזַרְעָ֔ם אִ֥ם מִיִּשְׂרָאֵ֖ל הֵֽם׃

controles.web: These were those who went up from Tel Melah, Tel Harsha, Cherub, Addan, and Immer; but they could not show their fathers’ houses, and their seed, whether they were of Israel:
controles.kjv: And these were they which went up from Tel–melah, Tel–harsa, Cherub, Addan, and Immer: but they could not shew their father’s house, and their seed, whether they were of Israel:
controles.livre: Também estes subiram de Tel-Melá, Tel-Harsa, Querube, Adã, e Imer, porém não puderam mostrar a família  de seus pais, nem sua linhagem, se eram de Israel:

versos.hebraico: בְּנֵי־דְלָיָ֥ה בְנֵי־טוֹבִיָּ֖ה בְּנֵ֣י נְקוֹדָ֑א שֵׁ֥שׁ מֵא֖וֹת חֲמִשִּׁ֥ים וּשְׁנָֽיִם׃ס

controles.web: the children of Delaiah, the children of Tobiah, the children of Nekoda, six hundred fifty-two.
controles.kjv: The children of Delaiah, the children of Tobiah, the children of Nekoda, six hundred fifty and two.
controles.livre: Os filhos de Delaías, os filhos de Tobias, os filhos de Necoda, seiscentos e cinquenta e dois.

versos.hebraico: וּמִבְּנֵי֙ הַכֹּ֣הֲנִ֔ים בְּנֵ֥י חֳבַיָּ֖ה בְּנֵ֣י הַקּ֑וֹץ בְּנֵ֣י בַרְזִלַּ֗י אֲשֶׁ֣ר לָ֠קַח מִבְּנ֞וֹת בַּרְזִלַּ֤י הַגִּלְעָדִי֙ אִשָּׁ֔ה וַיִּקָּרֵ֖א עַל־שְׁמָֽם׃

controles.web: Of the children of the priests: the children of Habaiah, the children of Hakkoz, the children of Barzillai, who took a wife of the daughters of Barzillai the Gileadite, and was called after their name.
controles.kjv: And of the children of the priests: the children of Habaiah, the children of Koz, the children of Barzillai; which took a wife of the daughters of Barzillai the Gileadite, and was called after their name:
controles.livre: E dos filhos dos sacerdotes: os filhos de Habaías, os filhos de Coz, os filhos de Barzilai, o qual tomou mulher das filhas de Barzilai gileadita, e foi chamado pelo nome delas.

versos.hebraico: אֵ֗לֶּה בִּקְשׁ֧וּ כְתָבָ֛ם הַמִּתְיַחְשִׂ֖ים וְלֹ֣א נִמְצָ֑אוּ וַֽיְגֹאֲל֖וּ מִן־הַכְּהֻנָּֽה׃

controles.web: These sought their place among those who were registered by genealogy, but they were not found: therefore were they deemed polluted and put from the priesthood.
controles.kjv: These sought their register among those that were reckoned by genealogy, but they were not found: therefore were they, as polluted, put from the priesthood.
controles.livre: Estes buscaram seu registro de genealogias, mas não foi achado; por isso foram rejeitados do sacerdócio.

versos.hebraico: וַיֹּ֤אמֶר הַתִּרְשָׁ֨תָא֙ לָהֶ֔ם אֲשֶׁ֥ר לֹא־יֹאכְל֖וּ מִקֹּ֣דֶשׁ הַקֳּדָשִׁ֑ים עַ֛ד עֲמֹ֥ד כֹּהֵ֖ן לְאוּרִ֥ים וּלְתֻמִּֽים׃

controles.web: The governor said to them, that they should not eat of the most holy things, until there stood up a priest with Urim and with Thummim.
controles.kjv: And the Tirshatha said unto them, that they should not eat of the most holy things, till there stood up a priest with Urim and with Thummim.
controles.livre: E o governador lhes mandou que não comessem das coisas sagradas, até que houvesse sacerdote com Urim e Tumim.

versos.hebraico: כָּל־הַקָּהָ֖ל כְּאֶחָ֑ד אַרְבַּ֣ע רִבּ֔וֹא אַלְפַּ֖יִם שְׁלֹשׁ־מֵא֥וֹת שִׁשִּֽׁים׃

controles.web: The whole assembly together was forty-two thousand three hundred sixty,
controles.kjv: The whole congregation together was forty and two thousand three hundred and threescore,
controles.livre: Toda esta congregação junta foi quarenta e dois mil trezentos e sessenta,

versos.hebraico: מִ֠לְּבַד עַבְדֵיהֶ֤ם וְאַמְהֹֽתֵיהֶם֙ אֵ֔לֶּה שִׁבְעַ֣ת אֲלָפִ֔ים שְׁלֹ֥שׁ מֵא֖וֹת שְׁלֹשִׁ֣ים וְשִׁבְעָ֑ה וְלָהֶ֛ם מְשֹׁרְרִ֥ים וּֽמְשֹׁרְר֖וֹת מָאתָֽיִם׃

controles.web: besides their male servants and their female servants, of whom there were seven thousand three hundred thirty-seven: and they had two hundred singing men and singing women.
controles.kjv: Beside their servants and their maids, of whom there were seven thousand three hundred thirty and seven: and there were among them two hundred singing men and singing women.
controles.livre: Sem seus servos e servas, os quais foram sete mil trezentos trinta e sete; também tinham duzentos cantores e cantoras.

versos.hebraico: סוּסֵיהֶ֕ם שְׁבַ֥ע מֵא֖וֹת שְׁלֹשִׁ֣ים וְשִׁשָּׁ֑ה פִּרְדֵיהֶ֕ם מָאתַ֖יִם אַרְבָּעִ֥ים וַחֲמִשָּֽׁה׃

controles.web: Their horses were seven hundred thirty-six; their mules, two hundred forty-five;
controles.kjv: Their horses were seven hundred thirty and six; their mules, two hundred forty and five;
controles.livre: Seus cavalos foram setecentos e trinta e seis; seus mulos, duzentos e quarenta e cinco;

versos.hebraico: גְּמַ֨לֵּיהֶ֔ם אַרְבַּ֥ע מֵא֖וֹת שְׁלֹשִׁ֣ים וַחֲמִשָּׁ֑ה חֲמֹרִ֕ים שֵׁ֣שֶׁת אֲלָפִ֔ים שְׁבַ֥ע מֵא֖וֹת וְעֶשְׂרִֽים׃פ

controles.web: their camels, four hundred thirty-five; their donkeys, six thousand seven hundred and twenty.
controles.kjv: Their camels, four hundred thirty and five; their asses, six thousand seven hundred and twenty.
controles.livre: Seus camelos, quatrocentos trinta e cinco; asnos, seis mil setecentos e vinte.

versos.hebraico: וּמֵרָאשֵׁי֙ הָֽאָב֔וֹת בְּבוֹאָ֕ם לְבֵ֥ית יְהוָ֖ה אֲשֶׁ֣ר בִּירוּשָׁלִָ֑ם הִֽתְנַדְּבוּ֙ לְבֵ֣ית הָֽאֱלֹהִ֔ים לְהַעֲמִיד֖וֹ עַל־מְכוֹנֽוֹ׃

controles.web: Some of the heads of fathers’ households, when they came to Yahweh’s house which is in Jerusalem, offered willingly for God’s house to set it up in its place:
controles.kjv: And some of the chief of the fathers, when they came to the house of the Lord which is at Jerusalem, offered freely for the house of God to set it up in his place:
controles.livre: E alguns dos chefes de famílias, quando vieram à casa do SENHOR que estava em Jerusalém, deram ofertas voluntárias para a casa de Deus, para a reconstruírem em seu lugar.

versos.hebraico: כְּכֹחָ֗ם נָתְנוּ֮ לְאוֹצַ֣ר הַמְּלָאכָה֒ זָהָ֗ב דַּרְכְּמוֹנִים֙ שֵׁשׁ־רִבֹּ֣אות וָאֶ֔לֶףס וְכֶ֕סֶף מָנִ֖ים חֲמֵ֣שֶׁת אֲלָפִ֑ים וְכָתְנֹ֥ת כֹּהֲנִ֖ים מֵאָֽה׃ס

controles.web: they gave after their ability into the treasury of the work sixty-one thousand darics of gold, and five thousand minas of silver, and one hundred priests’ garments.
controles.kjv: They gave after their ability unto the treasure of the work threescore and one thousand drams of gold, and five thousand pound of silver, and one hundred priests’ garments.
controles.livre: Conforme sua capacidade deram ao tesouro da obra sessenta e uma mil dracmas de ouro, cinco mil libras de prata, e cem vestes sacerdotais.

versos.hebraico: וַיֵּשְׁב֣וּ הַכֹּהֲנִ֣ים וְ֠הַלְוִיִּם וּֽמִן־הָעָ֞ם וְהַמְשֹׁרְרִ֧ים וְהַשּׁוֹעֲרִ֛ים וְהַנְּתִינִ֖ים בְּעָרֵיהֶ֑ם וְכָל־יִשְׂרָאֵ֖ל בְּעָרֵיהֶֽם׃ס

controles.web: So the priests, and the Levites, and some of the people, and the singers, and the porters, and the Nethinim, lived in their cities, and all Israel in their cities.
controles.kjv: So the priests, and the Levites, and some of the people, and the singers, and the porters, and the Nethinims, dwelt in their cities, and all Israel in their cities.
controles.livre: E os sacerdotes, os Levitas, os do povo, os cantores, os porteiros e os servos do templo, habitaram em suas cidades; como também todo Israel em suas cidades.
